annotations.title: Pin, hide or place products on a Shop the post tile

description: Pin a post's tile to the front of the bio page's Shop the post grid, hide it from the page, or place its products on its picture. A hidden tile keeps its products and counts, and shows again once hidden is false. spots puts numbered dots on the picture in the post's sheet, so a visitor taps the shirt in the photo and gets the shirt: look at the picture with shop_post_get first, then give each product's x and y in percent of the picture from its top left corner. Only products on the post, each once; [] takes them all off. Spots belong to that picture: once the post's first photo changes, place them again. post_id is a post_id from shop_posts_list (a post, or a synced Instagram post).

hidden.description: true takes it off the bio page; its products stay attached

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

pinned.description: true puts it first in the grid (pinned tiles go newest first among themselves)

spots.description: Every product to show on the picture, replacing what's there; products left out stay in the sheet's list only

link_id.description: A product on the post (one of its link_ids)

x.description: Percent of the picture's width from its left edge

y.description: Percent of the picture's height from its top edge

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
